title: [Permissions] Add Where-Used and Permissions Overview navigation actions
summary: Navigation actions have been added to Permission Sets, Permission Set cards, Table Information, and Page Inspection pages to open the Permissions Overview page with optional filters for viewing related permissions.
key_points: New integration events in System Application Permissions Overview codeunit enable cross-app navigation
Permission Sets list and card pages gain Where-Used and Permissions Overview actions
Table Information and Page Inspection pages now support drilling down to permissions
Integration events allow BaseApp to handle page navigation while Permissions Overview remains in BaseApp
New PermissionsOverviewHandler codeunit bridges System Application events to BaseApp
